page.content:
Man-sized dromaeosaur from the Djadochta of Mongolia.

How Velociraptor connects

  • Topic: Theropoda — Velociraptor is a dromaeosaurid theropod.
  • Topic: Birds — Velociraptor's feathers and wrists sit close to the bird line among maniraptorans.

What is Velociraptor?

Velociraptor mongoliensis is a lightly built, feathered dromaeosaur, famous from the Fighting Dinosaurs specimen locked with Protoceratops — smaller than its movie image.

Key threads lead to Theropoda and Birds.
